title: My membership profile
display_name_hint: Leave blank to remove the name from this membership profile.
locale_hint: This preference applies to this membership's interface. It does not change institution content or account access.
fallback: When a preferred language is unavailable, the institution's default language is used.
choose_replacement: Choose an available language or the institution's default before saving. Choosing the default removes the saved preference.
read_only: Your profile is available to read. You do not currently have permission to edit it.
missing: No exact membership profile is available for this account access. Other available views can still be used.
unavailable: Your membership profile could not be checked. The institution's default language is being used.
